resources.name: Ni-Os experimental phase equilibria data

access.notes: Data compiled from literature: solubility limits from Köster & Horn (1951), Velikanova et al. (2002), Phillips (1964), Prigent & Joubert (2011); peritectic temperature from Velikanova et al. (2002); Curie temperatures from Crangle & Parsons (1960) and Köster & Horn (1951); magnetic moments from Crangle & Parsons (1960). The exact numerical values must be extracted from these publications.

resources.notes: Publicly available from the referenced papers.
